overview_description.description: Embedly provides a platform and suite of tools to make embedding and previewing links simple.  Embedly helps publishers and consumers manage embed codes from more than 100 Websites and APIs, including YouTube, Flickr, Ustream, Picassa, Hulu, Twitpic, Quantcast, and CrunchBase.  It automatically convert links from these sources into embedded media on the fly.

product.name: Embedly Cards
product.description: A responsive embed solution that displays rich media content such as images, videos, and polls in a clean, shareable format on websites.

product.name: Embedly Embed Code Generator
product.description: A tool within the Embedly Dashboard that allows users to create unbranded, customizable embed codes for rich media content.

product.name: Embedly Provider Program
product.description: A program that allows content providers to join Embedly's library to ensure their media content is delivered correctly across platforms.
